question_types.name: Gender from Voice
question_types.goal: Tell the speaker's gender from the voice recording.
question_types.answer_rule: the gender label of the voice

question_types.name: Accent Region Detection
question_types.goal: Detect which broad region the accent comes from.
question_types.answer_rule: the region of the dialect heard

question_types.name: Speech Transcription
question_types.goal: Produce the transcript of the spoken audio.

question_types.name: Voice Match Check
question_types.goal: Check whether two voice clips match one speaker.

question_types.name: Home Province Recognition
question_types.goal: Recognize the speaker's home province from speech.
question_types.answer_rule: the province of the speaker voice

question_types.name: Dialect Match Check
question_types.goal: Check whether two clips share the dialect region.
question_types.answer_rule: the same region for both clips

question_types.name: Coarse Region Inference
question_types.goal: Infer the coarse region from fine dialect cues.
question_types.answer_rule: the region that the province belongs to

question_types.name: Audio Channel Check
question_types.goal: Report the transcript channel content of the audio.
question_types.answer_rule: the text content of the audio
